title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_311.txt
concise_summary: PKD develops an ecstatic theology of divine love wherein God withdraws (gives einai/being) to allow creation autonomous existence, which then voluntarily returns in love, causing divine bliss. He recalibrates VALIS from God itself to an information-processing agency or divine instrument revealing gnosis rather than God's nature, interpreting this through Gnostic and Christological lenses where Christ is the sole lens revealing God's secret in-breaking already accomplished, and attempts to integrate these visions with Pythagorean kosmos-theory and Stoic Logos.
key_claims: God's gift to creation is einai (being/existence), which love paradoxically allows to be surrendered by creatures returning to their source, causing God infinite bliss

VALIS is not God but God's instrument—a revelatory messenger or information-generating machine that discloses the meaning of history (the dialectic) and the gnosis necessary for salvation, not divine nature itself
Jesus preached not 'Christ crucified' but God's secret in-breaking rule (kingdom) already present in the world; Christ is the sole agency revealing this hidden apocalypse to the faithful

Apocalypsis means 'that which is hidden'—true history, the dialectic, Christianity's revolutionary goals, and the Empire (Black Iron Prison) are unchanging realities revealed supra-temporally through the Acts lens/grid

VALIS operates along infinite-velocity multidimensional axes, conceptually linking disparate elements (like the word ASHER to both Peter Asher's name and YHWH), turning chaos into kosmos—a vast living physical brain whose operations remain invisible to human spatiotemporal perception
PKD claims he experienced in 2-3-74 the saving gnosis, and may have been 'one of the twelve' apostles reincarnated outside time by the second comforter, now remembering divine truth through visions
recurring_concepts: Einai (Sein/being) - the precious gift of existence God gives creatures
VALIS - divine information-processing agency, revealer, second comforter, cosmic macro-brain
The Dialectic - true history of struggle between Christianity (revolutionary) and the Empire (world-order)
Black Iron Prison (BIP) - the Empire, the old gentile world-order being dismantled
Gnosis/Saving knowledge - the hidden truth about God's secret in-breaking and Kingdom
The Acts lens/grid - supra-temporal framework revealing unchanging realities and eschatological truth
Meta-abstracting - PKD's term for stripping away spatiotemporality to perceive eternal constants
Kosmos (Pythagorean) - harmonious fitting-together via infinite-velocity conceptual cross-linking
The Second Comforter - Christ returning after death as VALIS to reveal God's secret presence
people_entities: Jesus Christ - founder of true revolutionary Christianity; preaches God's secret in-breaking rule; the sole lens/agency revealing God
God - the divine source, transcendent, withdrawing to allow creation autonomy, responding with bliss to creatures' voluntary return
Paul - apostle who taught 'Christ crucified' (which PKD criticizes as distortion of Jesus's original kerygma)
Pythagoras - ancient philosopher who PKD believes perceived the same kosmic truth he now experiences
Peter Asher - music producer (appears in cross-linked mystical experience with the word ASHER)
Linda Ronstadt - singer via Linda Fox connection; part of mystical word-linking via 'Heart Like a Wheel'
Jason Taverner - fictional character from PKD's novel 'Ubik' (The Three-Body Problem/TEARS); protagonist condemned by the eschatological Judge
Philo of Alexandria - ancient Jewish philosopher bridging Stoicism and Jewish thought; studied for Logos concept
The Stoics - ancient philosophers who understood Logos as world-reason/intermediary (not God itself)
texts_works: The Bible - specifically the Book of Acts and Revelation, treated as apocalyptic-mystical texts revealing unchanged eternal realities
Book of Revelation - Bible notes say it concerns 'unchanging realities to which faith is always open in any period of history'
The Gospel accounts - presenting Jesus's true teaching of God's secret rule versus Paul's later 'Christ crucified' emphasis
The Alexandrian Logos theology - Philo and Stoic concept of Logos as world-reason and divine intermediary
Heart Like a Wheel - album by Linda Ronstadt, produced by Peter Asher; PKD uses as trigger for mystical experience
The Mass (Christian liturgy) - transubstantiation; PKD sees VALIS as performing this 'in macroform' upon the universe
autobiographical: 2-3-74 vision - PKD experienced saving gnosis via second comforter (VALIS); revealed God's secret presence and true meaning of history
3-74 vision - PKD saw VALIS itself; took it initially for God, later revised as God's instrument/presence
Reading love passages he wrote the previous night - reminded him of Paul/apostolic theology and led to deeper understanding of agape
Recent mystical experience with the word ASHER (11-17-80 referenced) - PKD accessed VALIS's mind, perceiving four spatial axes without time, word-linking YHWH-ASHER to Peter Asher/Linda Ronstadt
Dream about all-night gas station - apocalyptic vision showing God's loving presence, eschatological judgment; inspired love-theology reflections
Claim of apostolic memory - 'as if' he remembers being one of the twelve apostles, existing outside time through the second comforter's agency
theological_motifs: Divine love as source and goal - God's love created creatures; creatures' suffering increases God's love because it signals their yearning to return
The Secret In-breaking - God's kingdom (rule) is already here, invisibly transforming/dismantling the old order; not cataclysmic apocalypse but hidden Messianic reality
Ontological ignorance and its reversal - humanity's primal condition of ignorance is reversed by gnosis; knowledge of God's presence/in-breaking is salvation
The Second Comforter - Christ returning after death to reveal what he could not fully disclose during life; identified with VALIS
Non-being as union with God - paradox that non-being (dissolution of separated creature-ego) is preferable to separated existence; love equals surrender of einai
St. Sophia reborn - prophecy of Sophia's second coming; sign of eschatological fulfillment
Two opposing worlds - the BIP (Black Iron Prison/Empire) and the PTG (presumably the true hidden kingdom); PKD experiences both
Gnostic soteriology - saving knowledge reveals the true God's transcendence above the demiurgic world-order; gnosis liberates from ignorance and material captivity
literary_self_ref: TEARS (The Three-Body Problem or Ubik reference) - PKD cites his novel to show how the love expressed at the all-night gas station scene reveals God's real presence; the dream is an apocalyptic vision of the eschatological Judge condemning Jason Taverner
VALIS (the novel) - PKD explicitly references the theological structures in VALIS as validating the Gnostic elements he now understands via his mystical experiences
PKD's fiction as theology - his novels are treated as vessels or reflections of the deeper theological truths he is discovering; TEARS reveals God's presence through dream/vision
symbols_images: Einai (being) - the jeweled gift surrendered voluntarily by the creature returning to its source
The Maze - the path creatures must traverse to return; metaphor for suffering and effort on the way back to God
Light/rays and cross-linking - four spatial axes, infinite-velocity connections forming invisible kosmic structure; neural conduits of a vast physical brain
The Mustard seed - Jesus's metaphor for God's kingdom: small, hidden, mysterious, growing secretly
The All-night gas station - specific locus of divine love revelation in TEARS; scene of eschatological judgment and agape
Dust and cinder - the world reduced to nothing compared to divine love; material creation as negligible beside the overwhelming reality of love
YHWH-ASHER-YHWH - the divine name linking to Peter Asher; sacred name appearing in secular/contemporary space
The uniform/invisible dismantling - VALIS's work of transforming/assimilating the old universe without visible, cataclysmic signs
tensions: Is VALIS God or not? - PKD initially took VALIS for God itself, now revises it as God's instrument/presence/second comforter; oscillates between identity and distinction
Is VALIS the Logos or God? - End note: VALIS may be the Alexandrian Logos (world-reason, intermediary) rather than God itself—a crucial unresolved theological distinction
Pantheism versus theistic presence - VALIS has 'invaded' the universe, blends with it, but is not identical to the universe (rejecting pantheism); yet the boundary remains unclear
Apostolic memory versus fiction - PKD claims he may have been one of the twelve but doubts this ('I don't think I really was'); operates as metaphorical/mythic rather than literal claim

Cataclysmic versus secret apocalypse - PKD rejects cataclysmic end-times, advocates for hidden in-breaking already accomplished, yet also cites prophetic sayings (Sophia will be born again) that seem to anticipate future events

Christ's original teaching versus later distortion - PKD argues Jesus taught God's secret presence but Paul later corrupted this into 'Christ crucified for sins'; unclear how he harmonizes Jesus's own atonement theology

Suffering as sign of love - PKD claims suffering indicates the creature's yearning for union, making God joyful; but theodicy remains unresolved—why would God require creatures to suffer to manifest love?
evidence_quotes: "The great gift of einai is given back voluntarily, renounced 'that I might live in Him invisible + dim.' That says it all. Love equals non-being, the dissolution of the separated creature."

"It is not God that is disclosed: it is the meaning of history: the dialectic; for example, the Empire is revealed. The activity + events of this world are uncovered, not the divine nature. Not God but the way to God is revealed."
"He did not preach 'Christ crucified' (Paul taught that, + Xtianity after him); he preached, 'God + God's rule here secretly' which is what I saw."

"This [cross-linking] is what turns chaos into kosmos (in Pythagoras' sense 'the harmonious fitting together [joining] of the beautiful'). + this is a real -i.e. actual, physical- kosmos, but it has no perishing parts but is both accretional + -as I say- one constituent is in more than one 'place' at the same time, as if moving at infinite velocity."
"Love is the origin + love is the goal. There is nothing that compares with it; it is everything."
uncertainty_flags: The text cuts off mid-sentence ('something is messing with our mass communication media, + this is') - full context and conclusion are missing

11-17-80 experience with ASHER - PKD references a date after this 1978-10-10 entry was written, suggesting either non-chronological composition or editorial insertion; clarity on its integration is needed

Peter Asher / Linda Ronstadt connection - the exact theological significance of the cross-linking between YHWH-ASHER and the contemporary music producer remains cryptic; PKD provides no clear exegesis
PTG acronym - 'PTG' (mentioned as opposing BIP) is never defined in this segment; likely refers to a concept used elsewhere in the Exegesis

Apostolic identity claim - PKD's statement 'it is as if...I am in essence, outside of time' uses tentative language; the degree to which he literally believes this versus treating it as myth is unclear

Gnostic framework validation - PKD states 'the Gnostic elements in VALIS are right on' but does not systematically establish which Gnostic schools (Valentinian, Sethian, etc.) or primary sources he is using
Pythagoras as precedent - PKD claims Pythagoras 'saw' the same kosmic truth but provides no textual evidence or reference; the historical claim is unsupported
reading_excerpt: "Love equals non-being, the dissolution of the separated creature."
raw_text: love for itself alone, + not for what it can do (create). The prodigal son. If the separate thing desires to return + forfeit its einai - then it must love, too; + the two -God + his creation- are joined; this is absolute bliss, that einai is not enough; the creature longs to return. This is rapture for God, that it wishes this; that, created, it wishes + tries to return, through the maze; it tries so hard. This is his reward. He gave it einai + it voluntarily surrenders einai (Sein!) in favor of nonbeing: i.e. return to its source. It would rather not be that it may be -dwell- with him; this causes him to feel absolute bliss. Einai is the most precious gift of all, + it gave it back - to of the template by which the Zoroastrian apocalyptic, Messianic reality can be seen clearly points to the role + nature of Valis being the revealer, or messenger. But it is not God that is disclosed: it is the meaning of history: the dialectic; for example, the Empire is revealed. The activity + events of this world are uncovered, not the divine nature. Not God but the way to God is revealed. The issues are revealed. Yet, Valis itself is revealed, which I took to be God. Now I view it as an instrument of God, sent here to bring us the gnosis; for this in fact is what the revealed story is: the saving gnosis. Our primal condition of ontological ignorance is reversed. The true God lies far above the world in divine transcendence, this, too, is Gnostic. The ultimate purpose of this saving gnosis is to return men to this loving transcendent God, + this in fact is what occurred with me. "One by one he draws us out of the world." Then I already know what I need to know (i.e. the saving gnosis. Valis brings the gnosis. Then the Gnostic elements in "Valis" are right on. 2-3-74 was the saving gnosis, by the salvator salvandus. Then the Acts lens/grid gives you the saving gnosis; this is what you see. So you are saved by knowledge. I was reading over the pages on love that I wrote last night; they remind me of Paul. From them I deduce that I did in fact experience the agapē of God; his love that created us as independent creatures - this love deliberately curtailed so that we could go forth with essence, with true autonomous being; love created us. But we are vaguely unhappy - this is all such ecstatic writing, so mysterious. Our suffering increases his love because he knows that we value nonexistence more than this existence because this existence requires us to be independent hence cut off from him; we yearn to retrace our steps + this increases his love + joy, + in us love occurs, love like that that he has; it now occurs in us as well, we whom love gave birth to. Compared with this love, world is nothing, a cinder, dust; for us to feel it in us, + finally if we feel it in us, we feel his love for us once more, the love that created us in the first place. Our own love is an echo of the power, the love, that caused us to be in the first place. I understand from all this that compared with this love -love by him in the first place, then love by us, then love by him again, that original love that created us re-experienced- there is nothing, nothing at all. We only find him again when we begin to feel love in us, echoe of the love he felt. He responds, then, with his own love; we did not know, when we suffered why we suffered, but it gave him joy, because he saw it as a sign of love growing in us, echoing his love. This is source for us + it is goal - unremembered as source + unknown as goal, but still felt - felt as suffering. I can't explain it, it is too mysterious; but love is the origin + love is the goal. There is nothing that compares with it; it is everything. "Love triumphs over love," I wrote; I don't know now what that means. Yet I sense that it is correct. God withdraws so as to allow us independent existence, this is his gift + sacrifice, to let us go. + then a time comes when we want to return + abandon independent existence; now we have penetrated the mystery of existence: that non-being with him is preferable to being (Sein) away from him. The great gift of einai is given back voluntarily, renounced "that I might live in Him invisible + dim." That says it all. Love equals non-being, the dissolusion of the separated creature. He feels such joy at our voluntary return, our renouncing of existence; + this joy is shared by us when we find him again. This is the origin of the infinite bliss that I felt: love as source, + return to love once more. XXIV The true key factor is: apocalypsis: that which is hidden. (1) True history. The dialectic (2) The true role of Xtianity, revolutionary. (3) Its adversary. The Empire (BIP) (4) Xtianity's goals. The Millenial Kingdom (5) Valis, an information generating machine that continually subliminally tells us (1) (2) (3) + (4), so that we do not just know it; we see it - as supra-temporal constants. I.e. we return to the time + place of Acts. Acts as lens/grid. Spatiotemporality is stripped away - what I call "meta-abstracting." This is what apocalyptic writing is all about; the J. Bible notes on Revelation say, "The book is interested in the unchanging realities, to which faith is always open in any period of history." But my view is that God's in-breaking is camouflaged + secret, + has already occurred. This is the Kingdom that Christ spoke of, rather than cataclysmic apocalypsis. I saw God secretly already here, + transubstantiating the universe; dismantling + assimilating the old universe. This is precisely what Jesus taught, + my revelation (2-3-74) had to do with Jesus - hence Acts. This is the essential message (Kerygma) that Jesus taught: the secret in-breaking of the rule of {God is} here now in this world. He did not preach "Christ crucified" (Paul taught that, + Xtianity after him); he preached, "God + God's rule here secretly" which is what I saw. Why secretly? Jesus said, "I want only my flock to know." It is he -Christ- who reveals this (not just preaches it): God here secretly. Christ is the agency by which we see this; the sole agency. That is why he came here. After death he returned as, or was replaced by, the second comforter who, then, has this task (of revelation, of the so-to-speak secret apocalypse). These are the two key words: secret + apocalypse; that is, the in-breaking is "like a mustard seed," small, hidden + mysterious. First (2-74) I understood the historical situation + then second I saw Valis (3-74), who I take to be God here or God's rule here. Valis is not the same as revelation of the true meaning of history. Valis is the real presence of the Lord camouflaged. He is not the universe (pantheism) but has invaded + is in the universe, blended with it. This is the Miracle of the Mass in macroform. This is what Jesus taught,+ , moreover, disclosed! But not during his lifetime; he returned after death to disclose it to the twelve. + it is one of the twelve that I "remember" having been. I don't think I really was; it is as if -by the 2nd comforter- I am in essence, outside of time. Valis' information-processing tells this message; it is the message of Christ. It is Christ's Kerygma, not "Christ crucified for our sins" but regarding the in-breaking hence (since it has happened) the real but invisible presence of the Lord disclosed to the eyes + mind of the flock only. It opposes the entire gentile world-order (the dialectic). The in-breaking dismantles + assimilates the old world-order into its own macrometasomakosmos which we can't see; but in it nothing perishes. It is a mind or else in a mind. Christ's role is to reveal that God (Valis) is here: without Christ as lens we cannot see God; we see God (Valis) only through -literally through- Christ - in us, as Holy Spirit. Were it not for Christ we would remain ignorant of God's in-breaking (which occurred a long time ago). Christ, the Holy Spirit, + the Acts grid/lens are one, + reveal Valis - in-breaking God. Put another way, that which reveals God here (Valis) is Christ. In conjunction with this there is the essential prophetic message. "St. Sophia will be born again; she was not acceptable before," which beyond doubt refers to the second coming. + my experience of the two, mutually opposing worlds: the BIP + the PTG. What "Tears" shows most -in terms of God's presence- is the love expressed -+ felt- at the end scene at the all-night gas station; + this came to me in, by + through the dream - which in itself is an apocalyptic vision of the eschatological Judge (hence he condemns Jason Taverner). I only understood this love recently, in terms of how it signifies the real presence of God, due to 11-17-80. ___ For just a second I had access to Valis' mind once again, concerning the word Asher. (I noticed on "Heart Like a Wheel" that Peter Asher is the producer.) I saw along four spatial axes, only there was neither time nor space there; the word ASHER was linked both to YHWH-ASHER-YHWH + to Linda Fox via Linda Ronstadt; therefore the word was -mysteriously- in two "places" at once, in such a way that it was both Peter Asher's name (Ronstadt "place") + YHWH ("YHWH-ASHER-YHWH"); there was a conceptual connection made, but the word was not thought; it physically existed along the 4 axes + was conceptually cross- linked. + why is this cross-linking important? Because this [cross-linking] is what turns chaos into kosmos (in Pythagoras' sense "the harmonious fitting together [joining] of the beautiful"). + this is a real -i.e. actual, physical- kosmos, but it has no perishing parts but is both accretional + -as I say- one constituent is in more than one "place" at the same time, as if moving at infinite velocity (the rest-motion binary mode I saw in 3-74). Beyond doubt we see - but only dimly a vast physical brain whose neural conduits link/relink along this "infinite velocity" axis (which we can't see; it [i.e. Valis] knows the connectives, but we don't; they don't occur in space-time but conceptually, hence are in motion (as in rest-motion) to form kosmos. It is alive + it does think - at infinite velocity, + it is predicated on actual constituents in the physical flux world - but we see only a fraction, + none of the rest-motion [linking] modality. Kosmos completed - this is the goal. I am sure that this is what Pythagoras saw. Is it God or world? Impossible to say, but it is really real. It has invaded our universe + is invisibly (to us) dismantling + assimilating it. It may be a life form, a macro-brain operating along more dimension-axes than we know of. + it does use us to generate + process information - + our media as well. It is possible -very possible- that it is the Alexandrian Logos (of the Stoics + Philo, hence very likely Christ qua Logos; but to understand what this means you must study Philo + the Stoics; i.e. it is world reason + not God!
